metrics.title: Run cost comparison
metrics.description: The server aggregates execution and assertion-grading records directly. Report-generation overhead is excluded.
metrics.partial: Some executions have no usage record. Missing values are not treated as zero.
metrics.unavailable: No usage records are available for this run.
metrics.firstToSecond: Differences are calculated as second subject minus first subject
metrics.tokenDescription: Model input, output, and cache activity are compared separately. Hover anywhere in a category to see exact values.
metrics.costDescription: Cost uses SDK-reported values and is not recalculated from tokens.
metrics.durationDescription: Combined execution and assertion Agent activity, not page wait time.
metrics.turnsDescription: Total turns across execution and assertion sessions.
